Master's degree in Employment Law, Business Administration, or Human Resources and/or equivalent experience/training.
4 - 7 years of related experience.

Performs complex accounting and risk finance related to the monitoring of risk control strategies and programs. Implements risk control programs and strategies to prevent losses and reduce insurance premiums. (40% time)

Implements and monitors control strategies and programs involving claim payments. Assesses deductibles, pursues subrogation opportunities, and recommends cost allocation strategies to improve program effectiveness. (30% time)
Gathers, analyzes, prepares, and summarizes areas of potential loss; recommends appropriate type and level of loss protection to be implemented. (20% time)

Policy Development: Provide recommendations for and assist in the development, customization, and implementation of policies, procedures, employee handbooks, employment agreements, and related forms. Assist with updating policies in accordance with evolving laws and regulations. (10% time)
Read/Comprehend: Constantly
Write: Constantly
Perform Calculations: Constantly
Communicate Orally: Constantly
Reason & Analyze: Constantly
Sit: Frequently
Stand: Occasionally
Walk: Occasionally

Thorough knowledge in the following areas: risk management; insurance; forecasting and analysis; accounting; knowledge of common organization-specific computer application programs; knowledge of organizational processes and procedures; understanding of organization rules and regulations.
Proven interpersonal skills, customer service orientation, active listening skills, and organizational skills.
Proven ability to concisely present complex risk findings and make recommendations verbally and in writing.
Proven ability to use critical thinking and analytical skills to solve problems.
Strong skills required to develop course materials and deliver content effectively to diverse populations.
Deep knowledge of California employment laws and HR best practices; practical, business-oriented problem solving. Strong knowledge of EPLI policies, coverage, and claims processes.
Proactive mindset; ability to manage multiple engagements independently while fostering a positive workplace culture.
Extensive knowledge and experience with Microsoft Office Suite – Excel, charts, graphs, analytical tools, project management tools, PowerPoint
